# Climato

> Climato, by Faircode, is an all-in-one weather forecast companion app: live local conditions, global city search, Skye (an AI Weather Assistant), Favorites, and Nearby Explorer. Free on iOS and Android.

## Key facts

- Name: Climato
- Developer: Faircode (https://faircodetech.com)
- Platforms: iOS and Android
- Price: Free
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/climato/id6755456353
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.climato

## Features

- Live Local Weather: real-time temperature, humidity, rain, wind, UV index, and visibility for your location.
- Search Any City: forecasts for any city or town in the world.
- Chat with Skye: an AI Weather Assistant that explains the forecast in plain language, not just reports it.
- Favorites List: pin frequently checked cities and see their weather at a glance.
- Nearby Explorer: weather for nearby towns, workplaces, and landmarks, with distance and walk time to each.

## FAQ

- What is Climato? A weather app that blends live forecast data, local conditions, and a conversational AI assistant so you can understand the weather and act on it quickly.
- How does Skye help? Ask it plain-language questions, like whether to carry a jacket or what a visibility reading means for driving, and it answers using the live forecast for your location.
- Is Climato free? Yes, on both the App Store and Google Play.
- Can I check weather for another city? Yes, Search Any City covers any city or town worldwide.
